title: サーバ管理入門
subtitle: Introduction to Server Management
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn basic Linux operations such as files and directories, document creation, program compilation, and webpage publishing. (2) Perform these operations by keyboard commands. (3) Learn to use basic network commands such as telnet and ftp.
advice: This is a basic course on Linux operations within which we will cover the following materials: 1. Linux command line operation - files and directories - OS functions and commands 2. Multipurpose editor "emacs" - create, save, and print Japanese documents - create, compile, and execute C program - create webpages and publish them on a web server 3. Network - e-mail - basic network commands such as telnet and ftp (ssh and sftp) - client-server system

requiredKnowledge: Sufficient skill to operate a personal computer via keyboard entries.
